summary.final_text:
I added 150 µL of PBS buffer to each of assay_plate wells A1, A2 and A3, taking the PBS from reagents:A1.

Each well got its own tip pick-up, 150 µL aspirate, dispense and tip drop, since 450 µL would not fit in one 300 µL tip. All 12 jobs reported "executed". The PBS stock went from 40,000 µL to 39,550 µL. I did not read the plate.

task_def.source: Basic plate set-up: dispensing buffer into wells, the first step of most plate assays.
task_def.prompt: Add 150 uL of PBS buffer to each of assay_plate wells A1, A2 and A3.
